notes: Two dimensions: KIND tags under the skill that uses the item (skilling > smithing > metal-bar, crafting > uncut-gem, fletching > unstrung-bow, herblore > grimy-herb, cooking > raw-fish, construction > plank, runecraft > talisman, woodcutting > log > pyre-log, mining > ore, sailing > ship-part), and FAMILY tags under material, grouped by family type (material > metal > rune, material > wood > maple, material > herb > ranarr, material > gem > ruby, material > dragonhide > blue-dragonhide, material > fish > shark). The family groups (metal, wood, herb, gem, dragonhide, fish) have no rule of their own and let the app give one family type related colours. Family rules are deliberately broad (wiki metal/gem categories, or the family word in the name) so the same tag lands on ore, bar, equipment, seed, sapling, potion (unf), bolts and jewellery across every domain; other proposals can reuse these keys without redefining them. Judgement calls: (1) the Magic-wood family is keyed 'magic-wood' with a closed name list, because 'magic' is the shared Magic skill tag and 'Magic stone' / 'Magic potion' are not wood. (2) Normal logs family is 'normal-wood', not 'normal'. (3) Red topaz family is keyed 'topaz'. (4) The wiki 'Rune' category also holds god/gilded/Dragonstone armour and rune armour sets (rune-tier items), so they get 'rune' too. (5) Logs are under woodcutting, but 'fletching' and 'firemaking' also match logs directly; raw fish are under cooking (the skill that buys them), not fishing. (6) Mining/woodcutting are only grouping parents here; tool and gathering items are left to the gathering proposal. (7) 'sailing' is a new skill tag under skilling (not in the README list) for hull/keel parts and repair kits. (8) Fish families cover the 16 main cooked fish only; less traded species (cod, pike, herring, Sailing fish) are tagged raw-fish without a family. (9) Herblore secondaries come straight from the wiki category, which includes crossover items such as Raw haddock, Silver bar and Superior dragon bones. Left out on purpose (other domains or too small to tag): runes, tools (chisel, saw, tinderbox), lanterns and candles, toys, butterfly/impling jars, Sailing paints, dyes. The domain has 129 tags, a little over the ~120 guideline, because of the per-family tags.
